A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same MPO research. The text, equations, figures, tables, and appendices A–D support reliable comparison, including matching retained material across pagination changes.

before.justification: v1 reports original benchmark experiments across image, video, and molecular tasks, together with ablations, efficiency measurements, and qualitative analyses.

after.justification: v2 retains these original experiments and adds comparative bird-classification cases and an error-correction finding in Appendix C.3.

M1.justification: The joint multimodal updates, generation/edit/mix operators, and prior-inherited Bayesian UCB remain unchanged. Added beam-search explanations and mixed-parent prior details clarify the framework; Algorithms 1–2 are substantively unchanged.

E1.justification: The same ten benchmarks and their subtasks are retained. The added Grosbeak and Auklet examples concern CUB subtasks already evaluated in v1, without new task requirements or input conditions.

E2.justification: Benchmark and ablation comparator memberships remain unchanged. SEE, featured in the new qualitative cases, was already compared with MPO on both CUB subtasks in Table 6.

E3.justification: Appendix C.3 adds an evaluation criterion: the proportion of SEE's Auklet misclassifications corrected by MPO. Existing splits, model configurations, optimization budgets, and accuracy/F1 evaluation settings remain unchanged.

E4.justification: Appendix C.3 adds paired SEE/MPO prompt-and-response case studies for Grosbeak and Auklet, plus an analysis of correction of SEE errors. These extend v1's prompt/operator illustrations; the existing ablations and sensitivity analyses are retained.

E5.justification: Three-run averaging, Figure 4's median/quartile reporting, and Figure 3's correlation statistics are unchanged. The added cases introduce no new run counts, uncertainty estimates, or significance procedures.

E6.justification: v2 newly reports correction of 66.6% of SEE's Auklet errors and displayed-prompt scores: SEE/MPO 96.7/100.0 for Grosbeak and 50.0/80.3 for Auklet (Tables 13–16). Original results in Tables 1–7 remain unchanged; these additions do not replace their averaged benchmark results.

T1.justification: The optimization objective, Proposition 3.1, and Appendix B's assumptions, lemmas, derivations, and proof are retained. Added explanatory prose does not revise the formal analysis.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same contributions: multimodal prompt optimization, alignment-preserving exploration, inherited-prior selection, and improved performance and efficiency. The added cases support these claims without changing their scope.

C2.justification: Appendix C.3 adds a concrete interpretation linking SEE's errors to vague verbal attributes and MPO's corrections to direct visual grounding. Existing interpretations of alignment, optimization dynamics, and computational costs remain unchanged.

D1.justification: Section 3.3 newly specifies averaging parent posterior means for mix-generated children, while Section 3.2 makes parent/child handling more explicit. Additional optimized prompts are disclosed in the case studies. Appendix A's settings and algorithms remain unchanged, and both versions already provide the same code link.

R1.justification: v2 expands citations to Bayesian UCB, bandit-based prompt selection, APO surveys, DSPy, and molecular-language-model research, and removes the GPT-4V system-card reference. The central positioning against text-only optimization and instance-specific prompting is retained.

P1.justification: v2 adds localized method and DSG explanations, subdivides and expands Appendix C.3, and adds acknowledgments and equal-advising attribution. Most prose and the overall section structure remain intact.

P2.justification: Figure 1 is enlarged and redesigned with explicit answer examples. Four qualitative comparison tables are added, while existing displays are retained with some resizing and relocation; conference headers also change the layout.

improvement.justification: v2 clarifies previously unspecified mixed-parent prior handling and provides inspectable SEE/MPO failure comparisons, modestly improving reproducibility and explanatory support. The main empirical and theoretical evidence is unchanged, and the new 66.6% correction finding lacks an explicit error count or uncertainty estimate, limiting the strength of the additional evidence.
